# Third-party assets

Asset packs from other makers go here as downloaded, one folder per maker and pack, with the pack's licence file kept beside it: `quaternius/stylized-nature-megakit/`. Git ignores these folders, because the packs are large and paid ones can't be shared in a public repository.

When we adopt a model, it's copied into the client and committed, which is allowed only for **CC0** (public domain) packs. Paid models stay out of git. See [docs/ideas/assets.md](../../docs/ideas/assets.md).

| Pack | Maker | Licence | Kept here |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Stylized Nature MegaKit (Standard, the free version: 68 of 116 models) | [Quaternius](https://quaternius.com) | CC0 1.0 | the glTF models and textures, the licence, previews |
